gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with histologically confirmed glioblastoma per 2021 WHO classification at first progression according to RANO criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: Onfekafusp alfa (other names: L19TNF): Patients will be treated with 10 µg/kg L19TNF on Days 1, 3 and 5, and on Days 22, 24 and 26

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Safety and Efficacy of Different Administration Sequences of L19TNF With Lomustine in Glioblastoma at First Progression

role_evidence.quote: Open label phase I study in subjects with glioblastoma at first progression to explore two different administration schedules of lomustine for the combination with L19TNF (ARM 1 and ARM 2).

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational antibody-cytokine fusion protein (L19 antibody fused to TNF)

role_evidence.quote: to explore two different administration schedules of lomustine for the combination with L19TNF (ARM 1 and ARM 2).

Arm 2: Patients will be treated in escalating cohorts of 6 patients with lomustine at different doses (90 mg/m2 and 110 mg/m2) on Day 5 (in the evening after infusion of L19TNF) of a 42-day cycle for up to a maximum of 6 cycles.

source_quote.quote: MGMT promotor methylation status known or tumor tissue for analysis available.

coder_notes: Lomustine dose and schedule differ between arms and are the stated question, so coded established_therapy_experiment (rule 6 / R2) rather than soc_backbone. MGMT: inclusion requires status to be known or tissue available, but no specific MGMT status is required, so not coded as an eligibility (selection) biomarker; coded exploratory_correlative.
